capabilities: Publish notes or folders to reMarkable as PDFs
Transcribe handwritten annotations back into the source note
Manage files on the reMarkable (list and delete)
Cache transcription results by PDF hash to avoid re-paying
Verify dependencies and configuration with a health check
extras: Data egress: publishing sends note content through reMarkable Cloud; pulling sends page images to OpenRouter for paid vision transcription, gated by a consent modal. Only the Windows+WSL2 topology is end-to-end tested; macOS, Linux, and native-Windows setups are listed as untested and seeking testers. The plugin is a thin wrapper that requires installing a separate Python CLI (ormb); it is not self-contained. Not yet on PyPI; community store submission is still pending.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send notes to a reMarkable tablet for handwritten annotation and bring that handwriting back into the note as text.

relations.evidence: Publish Obsidian markdown pages to your reMarkable tablet as PDFs
Annotation transcription uses a vision LLM via OpenRouter.
the rendered PDF is uploaded to the reMarkable Cloud via rmapi
Pages are sent to a vision-capable LLM (GLM-4.5V by default)

requires.name: ormb Python CLI with rmapi and Playwright

summary: Round-trip bridge that publishes notes to a reMarkable tablet as PDFs and pulls handwritten annotations back into the vault as transcribed text.
